3.desc:
Egg Roll by Agri Kind is a dessert-forward, indica-dominant hybrid (roughly 70% indica) crafted from the celebrated cross of Chemdawg and Biscotti. This boutique strain earns its name from its distinctive, tightly packed buds that resemble savory egg rolls—dense, resinous, and layered with trichomes.

Appearance & Aroma
Agri Kind’s Egg Roll showcases bright emerald-green nugs accented by deep purple leaves and thin, fiery orange pistils, all blanketed in a frosty, shimmering coat of white crystal trichomes. Its aroma is a playful fusion of sweet, fruity plum and savory culinary spice, underscored by notes of black pepper, earthy sage, and a subtle diesel-gas finish.

Flavor & Effects
On the palate, Egg Roll delivers a smooth, dessert-like experience: upfront sweetness of ripe plum and berry gives way to a peppery, herbal exhale with hints of earthy spice and faint citrus. Effects begin with a euphoric, giggly head buzz that melts into deep, full-body relaxation—often culminating in couch-lock and dreamy sedation. Ideal for evening use, it’s favored for stress relief, anxiety management, chronic pain, muscle spasms, and insomnia.

68.desc:
Purple Rolling Papers and Pre Rolled Cones:
Like our original pink and unbleached rolling papers, these purple rolling papers are 100% vegan and made with only the finest materials. That means our papers have zero animal byproducts or harmful chemicals. The purple rolling papers have minimal impact on the environment as well, when compared to conventional rolling papers. This all translates to a slow, clean burn where you can taste your herb, not the paper, just like our iconic pink rolling papers.

Why Purple Rolling Papers and Cones?
From the start, Blazy Susan has been all about community, and bringing together like-minded people helping them see they are not alone. That became the driving principle behind this new line of rolling papers. The main difference, besides the color, is the charity initiative behind purple. We’re supporting mental health awareness and suicide prevention with the purple papers and cones. We want our community to know there are options out there, and it’s ok not to be ok. That is why we are partnering up with a couple of different mental health organizations. We are happy to announce that we have partnered up with The Trevor Project. The Trevor Project provides information & support to LGBTQ young people 24/7, all year round.

97.desc:
We are committed to providing our guests with medicinally potent products that harness the remarkable healing potential of cannabis. Rick Simpson Oil (RSO) is a potent, full spectrum extract that may capture a more complete range of the beneficial compounds in cannabis than other forms of extract. Pioneered by Rick Simpson during his battle with basal cell carcinoma, RSO gained acclaim as he attributed his recovery to its use and began sharing his discovery publicly. His work helped propel global awareness and advocacy for the medicinal potential of cannabis.

We begin with the full spectrum extraction of cured premium cannabis material. We fill fine mesh bags with cannabis and load them into our extractor with food-grade ethanol. The ethanol extracts cannabinoids and terpenes in addition to other beneficial botanical compounds to capture the full spectrum profile of the plant. We filter the solution to remove any undesirable biomass or compounds and then remove all of the ethanol using a combination of vacuum and heat to distill the alcohol from the extract.

After the ethanol is completely removed, we decarboxylate the oil. This chemical reaction occurs when we apply heat to the cannabinoid acids in the extract, such as THCA or CBDA, which are the non-psychoactive precursors found in raw cannabis. In doing so, we are converting our precursor cannabinoid acids to psychoactive compounds like delta 9 THC and CBD, respectively. The decarboxylation step is crucial to activate the beneficial effects of the final product for ingestion or topical use. This final processing step produces the dark, highly pure and potent RSO.

Our filtered and decarbed full-spectrum RSO is now ready to be either added into edibles or packaged into dispensers for wide-use applications. 

RSO can be ingested or applied topically. Due to the oil’s high concentration of plant waxes and fats, it should NOT be dabbed, smoked, or vaporized. One of the most popular and effective ways to take RSO is through sublingual administration – placing it under the tongue. The mouth’s mucus membranes allow for rapid absorption of cannabinoids directly into the bloodstream.

Please note that this is a very potent product, and we highly recommend discussing dosage and administration with a budtender if you are new to RSO.

102.desc:
Pie Dough Bx1 x Grape Pie Wedding Crasher

Though pheno-hunting is always something of a lottery, we often seem to hit the jackpot with Crystal Rose Seed Co.’s genetics. Producing winners like Pie Eyed, Wave Runners, and Watermelon Otai, their complex, one-of-a-kind crosses always have us coming back for more, and Grape Crepe is no different.

Prior to the creation of Grape Crepe, Crystal Rose had the opportunity to work with MegaRaw’s brand-building, in-house selected phenotype of Pie Dough, and he crossed it with his own Pie Eyed selection to create Pie Dough Bx1. He then crossed Pie Dough Bx1 with Grape Pie Wedding Crasher, a male known for its abundant resin and grape terps, to create Grape Crepe. Our cultivation team has selected two phenotypes of Grape Crepe: one for flower and the other for solventless extracts, and we have found this cultivar to be a wild improvement on the grape category as a whole.

Opening a jar of our flower phenotype, Grape Crepe #61, launches a purple wave of grape juice and grape candy streaked with a subtle gassy note – an aroma that translates impeccably to flavor with vaporization or combustion. A balanced combination of stress-melting relaxation and uplifting euphoria is consistent with its lineage of Pie Dough, Grape Pie, Wedding Cake, and Purple Punch.

Cerebral. Invigorating. Euphoric. All words that describe (Headband x ChemD) x Skunkdog Bx1. This standout from Matchmaker Genetics brings together two legendary cultivars of prohibition-era cannabis with a proven male stud used in over thirty outcrosses by the breeder.

Our selected phenotype grows with moderate vigor and a healthy spread of branches that bloom conical, Christmas tree-shaped flowers. Expect a slightly sour, diesel fuel-tinged aroma upfront from the Headband lineage, followed by a heavy-hitting chemical cleaner and fuel finish - classic ChemD.

The Hawaiian-bred Skunkdog Bx1, a staple strain on the islands, is known for its ability to withstand high humidity and thrive in even the wettest climates. This powerhouse male amplifies the acrid funk of Headband and ChemD and adds hardiness to the cross. While the flowering time runs longer than average, the payoff is worth the wait - a potent, complex expression of sour, skunk, and chem exploding from every bud.

105.desc:
Ice Cream Bananaz, the focus of our 2024 Pheno Hunt, shares its roots with Strawberry Cherry Pie and Sugarloaf Pineapple, as all three strains originate from 808 Genetics’ 2021 Strawberry Runtz menu. Despite having a parent in common, Sugarloaf Pineapple, Strawberry Cherry Pie, and Ice Cream Bananaz all yield wildly different results through the diversity of their maternal genetics. In the case of Ice Cream Bananaz, the mother strain, Ice Cream Nana, was introduced to enhance and amplify the foundation of Strawberry Runtz. It’s well worth getting to know all of the phenos in our hunt, as each is a unique expression of this cross.

Phenotype #46 of Ice Cream Bananaz is closely aligned to the paternal lineage of the cross and, more specifically, to its grandfather, Runtz. Commonly known in cannabis forums as the improved Gelato, Runtz is beloved for its sweet, juicy aromas and nostalgic fruit candy flavors. Looking and tasting like sugar-frosted candy, #46’s buds check all the right Runtz boxes and may provide an uplifting and euphoric experience to match.

119.desc:
Pie Dough x OGKB/TK

Crystal Rose Seed Co. is a family affair out of Maine started by the DoSiDos-loving “Dosi Drew'' and his partner Amanda. Focused on breeding cultivars with high resin content and unique terpene profiles, Crystal Rose has made a name for itself in Maine and beyond.

After sparking a friendship with fellow Maine transplant and grower MegaRaw Melts, the two decided to embark on a breeding collaboration. Crystal Rose is fortunate enough to be the only breeder to this day given the opportunity to use Mega’s fabled Pie Dough female. They pollinated Pie Dough with their own powerhouse male, OGKB/TK. Bud structure in the offspring is dense, with plants tending to have a cookie/chem-type structure. The resin is extremely greasy and almost wet. Aromas and flavors range from sweet dough and gas to cherry pie and hash.

Our phenotype (as is often the case with other Pie Eyed phenos) has a balanced mix of effects, giving the user vivid cerebral clarity as well as an overall sense of relaxation. The user can expect an initial feeling of alertness and sociability, followed by a calm that soothes the stresses of a long day. Some may notice more sedative effects with a release of pressure behind the eyes and a heavying of the eyelids."

Our Premium Rolled Joints are made with the same hand-trimmed cannabis as our Premium Flower line, never with shake or trim. They are machine rolled, rather than stuffed, to ensure ideal compression and an even burn. Cherry Pie x Strawberry Runtz

-------------

Located almost halfway around the world on Hawaii’s “Garden Isle” of Kauai, Strawberry Cherry Pie originator, 808 Genetics, is an exceptionally versatile breeder with a repertoire that includes preserving older varietals, working classics into tantalizing new crosses, breeding with the latest cuts, and stabilizing genetics. True to 808 form, our Strawberry Cherry Pie phenotype is a bit of the old with a touch of the new, yielding something equally enjoyable for both seasoned connoisseurs and adventurous newcomers alike.

A coveted Bay Area strain created by Jigga and PieGuy, Cherry Pie (Urkle x (F1 x Durban)), is a solid foundation on which to build any breeding project. As described by 808 Genetics themselves, Cherry Pie “has a terpene profile that is unmatched – a strong, sharp cherry aroma with a grape nag champa backend and notes of gas and pie crust.” The result of a prior breeding project that yielded both an eye-catching female flower producer and a studly male pollen provider, the Strawberry Runtz (Runtz x Strawberries and Cream F2) male eventually fathered its own line of seeds. As part of that lineup, Cherry Pie x Strawberry Runtz became known as Strawberry Cherry Pie.

True to its maternal lineage, Strawberry Cherry Pie is a plant of medium height that showcases deep green, purple-tipped flowers and tightly serrated fan leaves, making it a marvel to behold. The buds and sugar leaves are doused in resin and release a powerful wave of black cherry soda and tropical fruit punch that layers over unmistakable Cherry Pie aromas. Truly a delight for the senses, our phenotype also offers wholesome effects that soothe stress and anxiety.

128.desc:
Watermelon Zkittlez x Pie Eyed

Springing from the well that never seems to run dry, Watermelon Otai comes from a breeder that is likely already familiar to Breakwater regulars – “Maine-stay” Crystal Rose Seed Co. Our team’s success with Crystal Rose projects like Pie Eyed and Wave Runners has fueled our anticipation of yet another standout cross from this dynamic duo.

As fruit-dominant flavors seem to multiply exponentially with each passing year, watermelon has proven to be an elusive and coveted flavor that is difficult for breeders to capture. Pursuing this challenging prize, Crystal Rose crossed a Watermelon Zkittlez female with his Pie Eyed male. Growing similarly to its paternal lineage, our pheno displays average height and symmetrical branching. The flowers exhibit the maternal traits of the Zkittlez lineage, but with the added luster of Pie Eyed’s abundant trichome coverage. Resinous buds emit sugary-sweet watermelon and strawberry aromas, akin to a frozen tropical drink. After curing, a creamy undertone emerges to complement the candy-like layers of mellow watermelon and ripe strawberry, giving the strain its unique moniker, Watermelon Otai. (If you’re not familiar with “otai”-style drinks, you’re not alone! This Polynesian drink, originating in Tonga, combines coconut water, coconut milk, and tropical fruits such as mango, pineapple, and, almost always, watermelon). 

In Live Hash Rosin, the creaminess is exchanged for a more gassy profile which merges with those old-fashioned hard candy flavors. Delivering stress-melting effects that parallel Pie Eyed, Watermelon Otai’s tranquil, transporting relief is an on-demand tropical vacation.

Over time, the effects settle into a gentle body calm, muscles soften, tension disappears, and the world feels just a little softer. You stay clear, cozy, and glowing, like floating through a haze of pink sugar and satin smoke.

Crafted for those who crave flavor as much as feeling, Caviar Candy brings the sweetness of your favorite treat with the refinement of true caviar quality. It’s the ultimate balance, sweet like candy, smooth like caviar, and it’s always a vibe worth savoring.

Flavor and effects
The defining character is sweet strawberry and berry flavor with a smooth, refreshing finish. Caviar Sunrise may appeal to someone seeking a flavorful vape for socializing, creative activities, or daytime relaxation without an intensely pungent scent. For example, it could fit a weekend walk, casual gathering, or low-key creative session better than a nighttime, couch-lock-oriented product.

611.desc: Peanut Butter Cup is a highly popular, deeply relaxing indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain cultivated by Garden Greens in New Jersey. True to its name, this premium cultivar is celebrated for its decadent, dessert-like terpene profile and its heavy, soothing effects, making it a staple choice for evening unwinding and stress relief. Peanut Butter Cup delivers an authentic, nutty aroma that smells remarkably like a scoop of creamy, rich peanut butter mixed with sweet vanilla and a touch of candy sweetness. Breaking apart the dense, resin-coated nugs releases a sharp undertone of herbal spice and pungent earth. On the exhale, the smoke is thick and smooth, leaving a distinct nutty, sweet, and lightly toasted cookie dough flavor lingering on the palate. This cultivar packs a heavy "couch-lock" potential best saved for nighttime routines, lazy weekends, or a deep movie marathon. It lands with a soft wave of happy, hazy cerebral bliss that immediately shuts down racing thoughts and daytime anxiety. Shortly after, its heavy physical traits roll in, sending a deeply calming warmth across your muscles to melt away physical tension, stress, and chronic aches. It is widely favored as an elite sleep-aid or end-of-day recovery strain.

622.desc: Red Hotz is a slightly sativa dominant hybrid strain (60% sativa/40% indica) created through crossing the potent Tropicanna Cookies X Tangie strains. Named for the iconic candy, Red Hotz packs a delicious flavor and happy, bright high that is a great option for a lazy afternoon when you need to get to doing some things on your to-do list. The taste of Red Hotz is just like its namesake treat, with a sweet and sugary berry candy taste accented by zesty, spicy oranges and a hint of fresh red fruits. The aroma is very similar, with a spicy, peppery orange overtone accented by hints of earthiness and a touch of sweet fruity red candies. The Red Hotz high will wash over you quickly, filling your mind with a soaring sense of bright energy. You'll feel utterly euphoric and super creative, ready to get to work on anything artistic at hand. These effects will grow and grow with no ceiling, which can aggravate anxiety at times. In combination with its super high 20-25% average THC level, these effects make Red Hotz a great option for treating experienced patients with a variety of conditions including chronic fatigue, chronic pain, chronic stress or PTSD, nausea and depression or mood swings. This bud has fluffy and oversized, rounded forest green nugs with dark amber undertones, thin dark amber hairs and a frosty coating of tiny, sparkling gold-tinted white crystal trichomes.

661.desc:
Joint Custody from Gillie's Galaxy comes as a five-pack of hybrid pre-rolls. Customers describe the experience as calm, energetic and happy. The multi-pack makes it easy to share at a get-together or keep a few on hand for the weekend. Recent lab results put limonene at the top of its terpene profile, bringing a bright, zesty citrus note, followed by myrcene, with an earthy, ripe-fruit depth, and linalool, which adds a soft, floral lavender tone. That mix is what you smell when the package opens and what carries through on the inhale and exhale. Beyond THC, testing also shows measurable CBG and CBGA, minor cannabinoids that round out the overall profile. 

Hybrids usually land between sativa and indica and are often described as balanced, happy and easygoing. Being a hybrid, it works for a wide range of plans, from game night and cooking dinner to simply unwinding after work. Light the tip evenly while rotating, take slow draws, and let it rest between pulls so it burns clean and even. A multi-pack is easy to share or to spread across several sessions, and each joint stays fresh until you open it.

Expect layered sweetness, subtle earthy notes, and a smooth finish. Zaarie Irving begins with an uplifting, euphoric head rush before easing into deep full-body relaxation for a balanced hybrid experience.

663.desc: Coffee Cake is an indica-dominant hybrid created by crossing Koffee (Coffee OG) with Wedding Cake. This flavorful strain blends bold vanilla icing and sweet doughy goodness that deliver the perfect nighttime dessert high!

664.desc: Fluff Cake is a cross between Grape Pie x Wedding Crashers, making this strain a grape-forward delight. With the Grape Pie lineage often overpowering the Wedding Crashers, users can expect sweet, creamy, fruity, and grape notes, often with vanilla, berry, and earthy undertones.

665.desc:

Every strain is chosen for its flavor, aroma, and effect, not just a THC number. This is a smart pick when you want high-quality flower without a top-shelf price.

Crafted from greenhouse-grown, single-source cannabis, its THCA diamonds are melted and finished with a custom terpene blend for a bold, flavor-led vape experience.

Guava Lava is a balanced hybrid profile, often described as uplifting and easygoing with a relaxed body finish—great for unwinding without feeling overly heavy. Expect sweet guava, citrus, and tropical-fruit notes in a smooth, convenient cartridge.

667.desc: Jersey Boof is our own spin on the classic Super Boof you may have tried before. The finish often lands in a gentle skunky funk with a hint of fuel, keeping the profile "fruit first" but not overly sweet.

862.desc:
Blueberry Diesel is a flavorful hybrid that perfectly blends the sweet, berry-rich taste of Blueberry with the potent, fuel-forward punch of Sour Diesel. The result is a well-balanced strain that offers the best of both worlds — uplifting cerebral effects and soothing body relaxation.

Its buds are dense and frosty, showcasing shades of deep green and blue-purple hues, with bright orange pistils. The aroma is a mouthwatering mix of ripe blueberries, sour citrus, and pungent diesel, making it a favorite among flavor connoisseurs.

Blueberry Diesel delivers a clear-headed, euphoric high followed by a gentle, calming body buzz. It’s ideal for daytime or early evening use, helping ease stress, anxiety, and minor aches while keeping you mentally alert and uplifted.

863.desc:
Hypnotik is an incredibly potent hybrid strain known for its euphoric and deeply relaxing effects. This strain is ideal for those seeking an uplifting experience with a powerful sense of calm. A balanced blend of indica and sativa, Hypnotik delivers a smooth, calming high that may start with a burst of creativity and happiness, followed by a deeply soothing body relaxation.

Its sweet and earthy aroma, often tinged with hints of citrus and pine, adds to the overall enjoyable experience. Hypnotik is perfect for unwinding after a long day or as a companion for creative pursuits. Its well-rounded effects make it suitable for both daytime and evening use, though it’s best for users with a moderate tolerance due to its potency. Whether you're looking to melt away stress or spark some inspiration, Hypnotik offers a truly mesmerizing experience.

864.desc:
Elevate your routine without overcommitting. Our premium 3-pack pre-rolls is designed for those who demand top-shelf potency and flavor in a convenient, pocket-sized format. We start with exceptional, single-source flower, ground to perfection. Then, we infuse it with pure cured resin—capturing the deeply complex, authentic terpene profile and robust cannabinoids of perfectly aged cannabis. The result? A slow, even burn with a rich flavor profile and an elevated potency that hits well above its weight class.

Perfect for a solo session, a quick midday reset, or sharing with friends.

865.desc: Purple Starfruit is a calm and functional evening strain, offering versatile full-body relaxation paired with mental ease. The aroma is distinctively rich and layered with fruity candy balanced by earthy mint and subtle gas. This indica stands out for both its soothing potency and undeniable bag appeal.

866.desc: Sunny Daze is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain created from crossing Tangie with Sunny D. It’s bursting with deep orange flavors and a sweet yet pungent aroma. The dark green, medium-sized buds are a vibrant and generously coated with orange pistils. Much like a fresh glass of orange juice, Sunny D is a Sativa hybrid that could be perfect for kicking off the day and getting your mind and body energized.

The flavor mirrors the aroma, offering a creamy soda-pop taste with vanilla and sassafras notes on entry, followed by the diesel-garlic characteristics on exhale.

877.desc: Get Up Go Time Sativa is a sativa blend that is designed for moments when the day needs a jumpstart. The experience leans bright and motivating, with a clear, forward-moving headspace that helps kick momentum into gear without feeling scattered. Expect an alert, upbeat lift that pairs well with morning routines, creative tasks, or staying engaged on the move. This blend is rolled to deliver a smooth, reliable smoke that keeps things light, focused, and ready for whatever’s next. A solid choice when “later” isn’t an option and energy matters.

878.desc: Magic Marker is an indica-dominant hybrid that delivers a hazy euphoric bliss and super heavy body high. A bold cross of Permanent Marker x RS-11, this strain lives up to its name with an aroma that’s loud, funky, and sweetly complex. Expect layers of candy gas, creamy fruit, and a hint of earth, creating a rich sensory experience that lingers. Magic Marker is a strain that truly leaves its mark.

879.desc: Dark, juicy, and irresistibly smooth. Black Cherry Passion blends the deep, velvety richness of Black Cherry Noir with a bright pop of tropical passionfruit. Sweet meets sultry in this terpene-forward profile, delivering a lush inhale and a smooth, flavorful finish. Bold without being overpowering, it’s a perfectly balanced hit that feels indulgent and elevated.

880.desc: Bright, bold, and bursting with citrus energy. Boardwalk Lemonade is for the true lemon lover. Tart and zesty notes of lemon peel meet subtle sweetness, creating a crisp, clean inhale that feels like pure sunshine in vapor form. This daytime flavor is all about elevation. Sharp, refreshing, and made to keep the vibe buzzing.

881.desc: Decadent and dreamy, Cannoli Cream brings dessert to the sesh. Notes of vanilla bean and smooth, buttery sweetness come together in this rich, creamy profile reminiscent of a classic Italian pastry. It’s mellow, indulgent, and perfect for when you want dessert without the guilt.

882.desc: Zesty, sweet, and endlessly smooth. Orange Slice lights up the palate with juicy citrus flavor and subtle herbal undertones. This terpene blend brings the brightness of ripe oranges with a mellow finish, offering an uplifting, euphoric experience that’s as satisfying as it is refreshing.

883.desc: Zesty, sweet, and endlessly smooth. Orange Slice lights up the palate with juicy citrus flavor and subtle herbal undertones. This terpene blend brings the brightness of ripe oranges with a mellow finish, offering an uplifting, euphoric experience that’s as satisfying as it is refreshing.

884.desc:
Lemon Drop invites you to savor the essence of a sun-soaked summer with every inhale. This premium cannabis-infused distillate vape cartridge captures the perfect balance of sour and sweet, reminiscent of a freshly picked ripe lemon. The invigorating aroma of sharp, juicy citrus mingles with delightful candy undertones, creating a tantalizing scent that awakens the senses and sets the stage for a memorable experience.

The flavor profile of Lemon Drop is a vibrant celebration of citrusy brilliance. Each puff delivers a burst of zesty lemon paired with the sugary sweetness of your favorite candies, creating a mouth-puckering sensation that is both refreshing and indulgent. Enhanced by its terpene trio—Limonene, Pinene, and Terpinene—this vape cartridge offers layers of complexity. Limonene provides a bright citrus zest that uplifts the palate, while Pinene adds a subtle piney undertone for depth. Terpinene contributes a floral and herbal nuance, ensuring a smooth and well-rounded flavor journey that delights with every draw.

Experience a surge of energized inspiration with Lemon Drop, perfect for moments when you seek a creative spark or a boost of positivity. The uplifting effects invigorate the mind, fostering a sense of motivation and enthusiasm that enhances productivity and creative pursuits. Whether you're diving into an artistic project, enjoying a lively conversation, or embracing a day of exploration, Lemon Drop delivers a vibrant and uplifting high that keeps you inspired and engaged. Let Lemon Drop elevate your mood and ignite your creativity, making every moment brighter.

885.desc:
Clementine is a Sativa-dominant hybrid strain (70% Sativa and 30% Indica). First created by cannabis breeders Crockett Family Farms, Clementine is a mixture of Tangie x Lemon Skunk, resulting in citrusy and tangy flavors that are perfect for any sweet tooth. 

This strain is known for being used as remedies for many chronic health issues, such as lack of appetite, anxiety, nausea, fatigue, and depression. 

Similarly, the Clementine strain is excellent for boosting energy, gaining focus, and feeling euphoric. As a result, it’s one of the top cannabis strains for increasing your body’s energy levels.

886.desc:
Dawg Lemons, a crossing of Lemon Tree and Starwdawg, is known for its incredible taste, boasting intense flavors of citrus and a pine aftertaste that makes you feel like you're walking in a forest. The aroma alone is enough to get any connoisseur excited for a great session, as its zesty smell permeates through the room, filling the atmosphere with optimism and good vibes. Not only that, but it packs an uplifting and energetic buzz, leaving users feeling energized and focused with its light mental stimulation.

The moment you take your first puff of Dawg Lemons, your creative juices start to flow and the ideas begin to come. Every sense seems heightened, as you are drawn into a blissful state of motivation. You suddenly find yourself getting lost in thoughts and moments of clarity, each one more potent than the last. As the uplifting high radiates through your body and your mind, you feel ready to take on anything that comes your way.

Whether you're trying to finish a project, have an engaging conversation, or simply let your creativity fly free, Dawg Lemons provides the spark that will bring your imagination to life. Its heady effects create a dynamic atmosphere for innovation and exploration, allowing you to delve deep into the realm of creativity. For a blissful and inspiring journey, Dawg Lemons will surely be the fuel you need to get you there.

887.desc:
Dr. Funkenstein, also known as "Dr. Funk," is an indica-dominant hybrid strain cultivated by Royal King Seeds. Born from the legendary union of Blueberry and Bubba Kush, this strain captures the best qualities of its renowned parentage. Dr. Funkenstein offers a flavorful journey that delights the palate with a blend of sweet berry notes and earthy sharpness, reflecting its rich genetic heritage.

The strain's primary terpene profile includes Myrcene, Pinene, and Caryophyllene, contributing to its distinctive flavors and effects. Myrcene enhances the sweet, fruity aroma and promotes a sense of relaxation. Pinene introduces subtle pine undertones that can uplift and refresh the senses, while Caryophyllene adds a spicy hint that elevates the overall taste experience. This harmonious combination results in a flavor profile featuring berry, blueberry, cheesy, and sweet notes that make each encounter with Dr. Funkenstein uniquely enjoyable.

Dr. Funkenstein is celebrated for inducing a multifaceted experience that pleasantly envelops both mind and body. Users often report an onset of euphoria and cerebral stimulation, fostering feelings of happiness and creativity. As the journey continues, it gradually transitions into a powerful body sensation that promotes deep relaxation and a laid-back state. This progression may lead to increased appetite and a gentle inclination toward introspection, accompanied by a soothing, sleepy feeling. Drawing from its Blueberry and Bubba Kush lineage, Dr. Funkenstein offers a well-rounded experience that balances uplifting mental effects with calming physical relaxation.

888.desc:
GMO Cookies is a potent indica hybrid strain developed by Mamiko Seeds, born from the powerful cross of Girl Scout Cookies and Chemdog. Despite its name, GMO Cookies is not a genetically modified organism but a masterful blend of two legendary strains. This variety is celebrated for its unique flavor profile, featuring strong aromas of diesel, coffee, and fruit, with subtle hints of garlic, mushroom, and onion (GMO) inherited from its Chemdog lineage.

The strain's complex terpene profile includes Limonene, Caryophyllene, Myrcene, Humulene, and Bisabolol, contributing to its distinctive flavors and effects. Limonene adds a touch of citrus that uplifts the senses, while Caryophyllene introduces spicy notes that enhance the earthy and pungent aroma. Myrcene brings musky and herbal undertones, promoting a sense of relaxation. Humulene adds subtle earthy and woody flavors, and Bisabolol imparts gentle floral hints that round out the overall taste experience. This harmonious combination results in an earthy, pungent flavor with diesel overtones that linger on the palate.

GMO Cookies is renowned for its deeply relaxing effects that envelop the body while allowing the mind to remain focused. Users often report feeling relaxed, happy, and uplifted, enjoying a long-lasting high that soothes both mind and body. Drawing from its Girl Scout Cookies lineage, it offers euphoric and uplifting sensations that enhance mood and promote happiness. The Chemdog heritage contributes to the potent body relaxation, providing a soothing experience without total sedation. This balanced blend makes GMO Cookies a favorite among those seeking mental clarity paired with physical tranquility.

889.desc:
Lemon Tree Punch combines the sweet-and-sour tang of Lemon Tree and the fruity fragrance of Purple Punch. This variety smells strongly of lemon, grape, and berry, mixed with undertones of diesel fuel and wet soil. Lemon Tree Punch offers a rich flavor that is particularly complex. Depending on the phenotype, some plants may taste more of grape and berry, and others may be more citrusy. 

Lemon Tree Punch provides a balanced effect that is both stimulating and comforting. Users report that this strain boosts the mood and increases motivation when it is consumed in small doses. When consumed in greater quantities, this invigorating effect shifts into a mildly sedating stone that may reduce muscle tension and soothe the mind. Given its well-balanced effects, Lemon Tree Punch makes for a great all-day smoke.

890.desc:
Mintlato is a hybrid born of Animal Mints and Gelato 41, showcasing a terpene cast led by limonene, caryophyllene, humulene, myrcene, and pinene. At first draw, limonene brings a bright citrus zing that awakens the senses, while pinene’s fresh pine notes add a brisk clarity. Myrcene’s earthy, musky undertones lend a plush, soothing backdrop, and caryophyllene’s spicy warmth weaves through the mix, rounding out the flavor with a subtle peppery edge. Humulene’s herbal whisper ties everything together, creating a complex, mint-tinged profile that feels both crisp and luxuriant.

Onset is marked by a light uplift—limonene promotes a buoyant sense of optimism, lifting the spirit without racing the mind. As that initial glow settles, myrcene and humulene ease the body into gentle relaxation, melting away tension without heavy sedation. Pinene’s clarity helps maintain focus, keeping thoughts crisp even as a comfortable calm washes over you. The result is a balanced high that can fuel creative bursts, spark conversation, or simply enhance a lazy afternoon with a refreshing twist.

With its harmonious interplay of invigorating and soothing notes, Mintlato invites you to explore a variety of activities. Tackle a brainstorming session with newfound clarity, lose yourself in mellow music with a relaxed frame of mind, or savor a quiet moment of reflection as the minty breeze lingers on your palate - Mintlato adapts to your mood, amplifying joy and composure in equal measure.

891.desc:
Sunset Frost Cookies merges the sugary decadence of Sunset Sherbet with the potent, savory depth of GMO Cookies, creating a hybrid that embodies balance in both flavor and effect. From the first inhale, this strain delivers an intricate blend of sweet citrus, creamy vanilla, and earthy spice. Its aroma evokes a twilight moment in a summer garden: rich, fragrant, and soothingly warm. Each draw reveals new layers of complexity, with notes of fruit and spice melting into a velvety, dessert-like finish that lingers on the palate.

The terpene blend of Limonene, Myrcene, Caryophyllene, Linalool, Humulene, and Bisabolol shapes both the experience and its nuanced aroma. Limonene brings a bright citrus clarity that energizes the senses, while Myrcene adds depth with its musky, grounding essence. Caryophyllene contributes a subtle peppery warmth that enriches the sweetness, as Linalool lends a soft floral calm. The addition of Humulene and Bisabolol rounds out the bouquet with woody and honeyed undertones, giving the strain a signature aroma that’s both uplifting and soothing.

The effects of Sunset Frost Cookies unfold like a slow sunset, beginning with a wave of euphoria that lifts the mind before easing into a serene, full-body calm. The cerebral clarity encourages mellow conversation or introspection, while the physical relaxation melts away lingering tension without sedation. Perfect for winding down the day or embracing a peaceful evening, Sunset Frost Cookies offers a luxurious balance of sweetness, depth, and calm - an indulgent hybrid that delivers on every note.

924.desc: Rainbow Belts Premium Flower is a tantalizing strain that inspired the notation that you can “Taste The Rainbow". While high from this strain is known for producing an uplifted and creative headspace, it also works for relaxing the vibe in social settings.

925.desc:
Anthologie l Underground Tangie #5 l 3.5g

Lineage: Sour Tangie x Mandarin Sunset Underground Tangie is a dynamic hybrid strain created by crossing Sour Tangie, Mandarin Sunset, and Orange Velvet.

It is known for its robust growth and vibrant hues, often displaying dark purple colors that can shift to almost blue in cooler temperatures. This strain produces medium sized, resinous buds with a strong structure and solid lateral branching.

The terpene profile of Underground Tangie is rich and diverse, featuring prominent notes of orange spices, earthiness, and skunk. 1250.desc:
Mexican Landrace (Guerrero Mountains)

Sativa

Landrace (Guerrero, Mexico)

Acapulco Gold is a piece of cannabis history. A true Mexican landrace from the Guerrero Mountains along the Pacific coast near Acapulco, this sativa evolved on its own for generations—no breeder, no crossing, just a tropical climate and altitude shaping one of the most legendary strains the plant has ever produced. It hit the United States in the mid-1960s, rode the counterculture wave up and down the coast with the surfing crowd, and became a symbol of premium weed at a time when most of what circulated was anything but. Cheech and Chong name-dropped it in "Up in Smoke," and the legend only grew. The name comes from the distinctive golden hue of its cured buds—amber and gold tones threaded with rusty orange pistils and a coat of resin dense enough to earn its "gold" reputation. The nose and flavor are unmistakably old-school: earthy and woody with notes of toasted chestnut, tea leaves, and a whisper of pine and citrus. The high is pure vintage sativa—clean, energetic, and euphoric, a soaring cerebral lift that sparks conversation and creativity without the jitters or paranoia. A daytime classic and a living link to where it all started.

Cookie Monster x GMO Candy Live Resin

Balanced Hybrid

North Lake Supply (Nimbus Cannabis Co.)

Mendo Monster is a proprietary live resin cart born in North Lake Supply's New Jersey facility, blending two heavy-hitting strains into a single 510 cartridge you won't find anywhere else. The first half is Cookie Monster—a 2014 Seattle Cannabis Cup winner crossing Girl Scout Cookies with OG Kush, bringing sweet, doughy dessert notes over an earthy, piney Kush backbone. The second is GMO Candy, a dessert-forward spin on the infamous GMO (Garlic Cookies) line that layers bright, syrupy candy sweetness on top of GMO's signature diesel-and-garlic funk. Pressed into live resin and married together, the two create a full-spectrum experience that leads with a myrcene-rich, earthy base and opens into loud citrus and a spicy, peppery gas from the limonene and caryophyllene riding underneath. The flavor is exactly the tug-of-war the name promises: sweet cookie and candy up front, savory funk on the exhale. The high follows suit—an uplifting, euphoric lift out of the gate that mellows into a deep, grounding body calm, making it a versatile all-day-into-evening pull for anyone who wants flavor and weight in the same breath.

1256.desc:
Fatso x Cotton Candy — some Atlas Seed listings cite Pilot Light x Cotton Candy

Turtle Taffy is a modern auto flower standout from California breeder Atlas Seed, and it plays against type. Where most "taffy" and "candy" strains chase pure sweetness, Turtle Taffy pairs sugary confection with a loud, gassy funk—the result of its Fatso parent, a heavy GMO x Legend OG cut from the OG/Chem/Kush family known for savory, garlic-fuel depth. Crossed with Atlas's Cotton Candy auto donor, the sweetness gets pulled forward into a caramel-taffy candy note that rides on top of that funk. (Worth noting: some Atlas listings describe the cross as Pilot Light x Cotton Candy, so lineage accounts vary depending on the drop.) The bud finishes frosty and dense, with a terpene profile built on humulene, terpinolene, and linalool that gives it a sweet-and-funky nose backed by earthy spice. Because of the Fatso side, it's also a favorite for hash—dry sift or ice water. The high leans uplifting and energizing out the gate, sparking creativity and a fun, social mood before easing into a mild, comfortable fade. A great pick for a daytime creative session, an active hang, or any time you want something sweet with an unexpected gassy twist.

Ultra-pure THCA crystals with a terpene-rich sauce are used to make Liquid Diamonds, a concentrate. THCA crystals, called "diamonds," come about through controlled crystallization. Liquid Diamonds’ "liquid" comes from the obscene sauce the THCA crystals tend to get tossed into. There are a lot of terpenes and other minor cannabinoids in this sauce that make it richer and more flavourful. Such an amalgam of pure THCA and flavorful terpenes can be a balanced treat for those looking for high-concentrate concentrates with plenty of taste.

The scent of MAC is often musky and highlighted with sour citrus accents. Its taste has been described as being similar to biting a zesty orange, with sweet floral and earthen undertones. 1404.desc:
Peak Pro Link lets you bring Peak Pro performance to your favorite glass rig—so you can ditch torches, timers, and guessing temps. It connects your Peak Pro base to a banger-style setup and uses real-time temperature control with customizable heat settings for bigger clouds and bold flavor at the push of a button. It’s an easy way to give new life to glass you already love, with compatibility for Peak Pro 3D and 3DXL Chambers (Peak Pro and chambers sold separately).

Cleaning & Care:
> Chamber: Swab after each dab; deep clean with 90%+ isopropyl alcohol and let fully air-dry before heating.

> Link parts: Let everything cool completely. Clean the metal elbow, silicone joints, and stand with 90%+ ISO (you can soak elbow/joints for 20–30 minutes). Use an ISO-dipped swab on contact points. Do not soak the entire Link in ISO.

> If you see a red/white connection error, update firmware and clean connection pins.

Packaged as a convenient 1g pre-roll, it requires no grinding, rolling, or prep, making it an easy choice for quick sessions or everyday use. Sweet, smooth, and full of personality, Laughy Taffeze is a strong pick for customers looking for a flavorful pre-roll with playful candy-style character.

1421.desc:
Bring the sunshine wherever you go with Naranjas by Pete's Farmstand. This convenient, ready-to-enjoy pre-roll delivers a vibrant citrus-forward experience with notes of sweet orange, tropical fruit, and subtle earthy spice for a smooth, flavorful smoke.

Perfect for on-the-go sessions or effortless relaxation, Naranjas offers an uplifting, mood-boosting start that eases into a calm, balanced finish. Expertly rolled with quality flower, it's a great choice whether you're heading out with friends or winding down after a long day.

1422.desc: Bold, smooth, and full of character, Pete’s Farmstand OZ Purp is a sativa-hybrid pre-roll made for an easy, flavorful session.

1423.desc: OZ Purp offers a smooth, approachable smoke with rich purple-inspired character and a clean finish, making it a strong choice for casual afternoons, relaxed evenings, or simple everyday enjoyment. Easy to use and built for convenience, Pete’s Farmstand OZ Purp Ready-to-Roll is a dependable pick for customers looking for a value-friendly flower option with grab-and-go smokeability.

1424.desc: Pete’s Farmstand Sammy Suplex is a hybrid batch is led by beta-caryophyllene, limonene and linalool, a terpene combination associated with peppery spice, bright citrus and soft floral notes. Its balanced profile is suited to a versatile, feel-good session that can begin upbeat and settle into calm relaxation.

1425.desc: Pete’s Farmstand Sammy Suplex is a hybrid batch is led by beta-caryophyllene, limonene and linalool, a terpene combination associated with peppery spice, bright citrus and soft floral notes. Its balanced profile is suited to a versatile, feel-good session that can begin upbeat and settle into calm relaxation.

1426.desc: Summer Splash brings a bright, fruit-forward profile with sweet citrus, juicy tropical notes, subtle earth, and a clean finish that makes each session fresh, smooth, and easy to enjoy.

1427.desc: Bulgogi from Pete's Farmstand is a balanced hybrid that delivers soothing body relaxation alongside an uplifting, focused cerebral effect. It eases tension without causing heavy sedation, making it versatile for daytime or evening use. The strain features a nutty, grassy flavor profile with refreshing sour citrus notes, supported by terpenes like caryophyllene and limonene. Its smooth, earthy-citrus smoke enhances its calming yet motivating experience. Overall, Bulgogi is valued for blending relaxing physical effects with clear, energized mental stimulation.

1428.desc: Stock up on bold, savory craft value with Pete's Farmstand Top Shelf Bulgogi Small Buds (7g), a quarter-ounce of compact, trichome-rich balanced hybrid nugs. Named after Korea's beloved marinated beef dish, every inhale delivers a complex, peppery punch layered over nutty, grassy undertones and a bright, refreshing burst of sour citrus. Versatile enough for daytime creativity or evening unwinding, Bulgogi sparks a clear-headed, uplifting cerebral lift that sharpens focus and boosts mood before settling into a soothing, comfortable body relaxation without heavy sedation.

1429.desc: This hybrid brings a layered flavor profile of sweet citrus, woody spice, and a hint of berry on the exhale, giving each hit a complex, satisfying finish. As the name suggests, the effects come on gradually, lifting your mood, easing stress, and wrapping the body in a calm, relaxing buzz without knocking you out right away. It’s a great pick for evening sessions when you want to unwind, get a little spacey, and let the tension of the day fade away.

1430.desc: Kick back and unwind with Pete's Farmstand Top Shelf Day Off Mixed Nugs (7g), a quarter-ounce blend of full-sized and smaller chunky, trichome-coated indica-leaning hybrid buds. Every inhale delivers a smooth, inviting flavor profile blending sweet earth and creamy vanilla with bright citrus zest, crisp pine, and subtle herbal dessert undertones on the exhale. True to its name, Day Off opens with a gentle, happy cerebral lift that melts away daily stress before settling into a warm, soothing body buzz—making it an ideal companion for recharging without heavy couch-lock.

1431.desc: Meet Dosilato, a captivating indica strain that promises intense relaxation and calm. Born from the celebrated lineage of Do-Si-Dos and Gelato 41, Dosilato carries the robust genetics of its parents, delivering a serene, full-body high that's perfect for unwinding.

1432.desc: Treat your palate to candy-sweet craft value with Pete's Farmstand Top Shelf Laughy Taffeze Mixed Nugs (3.5g), an eighth of full-sized and smaller trichome-coated indica-leaning hybrid buds. Every inhale bursts with nostalgic, chewy fruit taffy and tangy tropical citrus layered over light creaminess, subtle earth, and a soft gassy finish on the exhale. Well-balanced and approachable, Laughy Taffeze opens with a happy, carefree cerebral lift that melts away stress before settling into a deeply soothing, comfortable body calm ideal for laid-back afternoons or unwinding in the evening.

1433.desc: Metal Face OG from Pete’s Farmstand is a classic-leaning OG strain with a bold, gassy profile and a heavy, relaxing feel. It usually comes across with earthy pine, diesel, and kush notes, plus a spicy, slightly sour edge that gives it a sharp finish.

1434.desc: Stock up on terpene-rich craft value with Pete's Farmstand Top Shelf OZ Kush Mixed Nugs (7g), a quarter-ounce blend of full-sized and smaller trichome-coated hybrid buds bred from Zkittlez and OG Eddy Lepp. Every inhale delivers a bold, layered flavor profile blending sweet tropical fruit and subtle honey-citrus notes with classic earthy kush, crisp pine, and a gassy, peppery finish. Well-balanced yet deeply soothing, OZ Kush kicks off with a happy, giggly, and carefree cerebral lift that melts away stress before settling into a warm, full-body calm ideal for late afternoons or unwinding in the evening.

1435.desc: Pit Stop is a well-rounded hybrid strain known for its bold aroma and flavorful profile. Expect a mix of earthy, gassy notes with hints of sweetness and spice, wrapped in a classic cannabis-forward finish. Its dense buds showcase rich tones and a sticky, resinous texture, making it a standout choice for those looking for a flavorful and balanced flower experience.

1436.desc: Pete’s Farmstand Silk Road pre-roll brings a smooth, travel-ready experience with a flavorful profile that leans into warm spice and subtle earthy sweetness. Expect soft herbal notes layered with hints of exotic spice and a gentle, slightly floral undertone that builds as you smoke. The aroma feels inviting and mellow, carrying a balanced character that stays consistent from first light to finish. Crafted for convenience, this pre-roll keeps things simple while delivering a steady, flavorful session that’s easy to enjoy anytime.

1437.desc:
Yoshi from Pete’s Farmstand comes across as a vibrant, modern hybrid. Leaning more toward sweet, fruity, candy-like flavors rather than the heavy, gassy punch of a classic OG. Yoshi offers a taste that’s brighter and livelier and sweeter than it is deep and earthy.

The effects, a cerebral uplift that enhances brightness and ability, offering a gradual smooth, relaxing bodily calm. This strain is often associated with afternoon or evening use, offering an enjoyable effect without inducing immediate drowsiness.

1438.desc: The "Papaya Crush" strain is an indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain. It is known for its tropical fruit aroma with creamy sweetness and papaya notes, and offers a balanced effect of uplifting cerebral effects and relaxing body sensations, making it suitable for creativity, socializing, or unwinding.

1439.desc: Unwind from the ultimate long day and just forget about it with the Pre-Roll King of Jersey Fuhgeddaboudit Hawaiian Fruitcake Bubble Hash Infused Pre-Roll (1g). This premium single joint expertly blends top-shelf Jersey-grown flower with melt-in-your-mouth tropical bubble hash to deliver a fast-acting, euphoric cerebral buzz that swiftly melts into deep, full-body relaxation. Bursting with mouthwatering island flavors, it is the ultimate top-shelf treat for anyone looking to melt away stress, enjoy an ultra-smooth smoke, and treat themselves to the true royalty of Garden State cannabis.

EV Family Farms’ Blue Limeade is a sativa-dominant hybrid offered in a premium 3.5g flower format, bringing a bright, refreshing profile to your rotation.

Expect vibrant aromas of fresh lime, sweet citrus, and tropical fruit for a zesty, fruit-forward experience. Its lively aromatic character makes Blue Limeade a standout choice for enthusiasts who enjoy crisp citrus and tropical notes.

The experience is balanced, clear-headed, and uplifting, making this flower a versatile option for daytime sessions, creative moments, or social enjoyment.

1474.desc: The Queen Green Frog Poison Smalls (3.5g) is a premium, high-potency cannabis offering curated for consumers looking for top-shelf exotic attributes in a cost-effective format. Packaged in standard eighth-ounce (3.5 grams) quantities, this product features small, popcorn-sized dense buds that retain the full chemical and genetic potency of the master plant.

1475.desc:
Heir Heads is a welcome addition to the Runtz family tree. This cross of Runtz x Apples and Bananas is icky-sticky, dense, and dank. The buds are dense and vibrantly purple with pops of green and orange, and a layer of resin that will clog up all but the cleanest of grinders. Heir Heads has a complex, herbaceous aroma with distinct notes of earthiness, diesel, ripe fruits, and spiced apples (think hot apple cider). Credit for this strain is unverified but is thought to have been created by breeder Kounter Kulture for Conception Nurseries, which now sells the genetics.

Users report Heir Heads has a balanced effect that starts with a burst of uplifting euphoria and ends with you settling comfortably into the nearest cushioned surface.

1476.desc:
Strain Genetics: Lemon Pie is a sativa-dominant hybrid created by crossing Amnesia Haze with Skunk #1.

Flavor/Aroma Profile: It is known for a very sweet, doughy, and skunky aroma with intense notes of lemon zest.

Effects: Users typically report an immediate, energetic, and cerebral high that is motivating and social, accompanied by light physical relaxation. It is often described as a "mentally sunny" strain ideal for daytime use.

1477.desc:
Oishii is a hybrid strain, with the most common lineage being a cross between Flavor Pack #7 and Moonbow 112 F2 created by Archive Seed Bank. 

Oishii is known for its sweet, citrusy, and skunky flavor profile and relaxing, full-body effects.

1478.desc:
EV Family Farms’ Sherb Cream Pie x Biscotti is an indica-dominant hybrid blending dessert-inspired sweetness with classic gassy depth.

Expect sweet candy and smooth vanilla cream layered with pungent gassy diesel for a rich, flavorful profile. The combination creates an indulgent aroma and satisfying smoke that balances creamy sweetness with a bold fuel finish.

This cultivar delivers a relaxing body feel paired with a calm, euphoric head high, making it a great choice for unwinding and settling into a comfortable evening session.

1479.desc: Queen Green Verzace Smalls (3.5g) is an indica-leaning hybrid cannabis flower product (often packaged as small buds or "smalls") featuring high potency and a prominent terpene profile.

1480.desc: Watermelon Crush by EV Family Farms is a hybrid cannabis strain created by crossing Superboof and SFV. It is known for a sweet, candy-like watermelon aroma with subtle gassy undertones, high THC levels (often ranging from 27% to over 34%), and dominant terpenes like limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene.

This potent hybrid delivers a fast-acting wave of clear-headed cerebral euphoria, creative focus, and physical energy before gently easing into a deeply relaxing, tension-relieving body calm. It is an exceptional daytime or early evening choice for elevating your mood, sharpening your mind, and melting away daily stress without any immediate sedation.

1490.desc:
The REJUV Recover Transdermal Patch is designed to provide balanced relief through a 1:1 ratio of THC and CBD. Each patch is infused with cannabinoids that penetrate the skin for systemic effects, delivering relief where it’s needed most. Ideal for those seeking both mental and physical relief, these patches are discreet and easy to apply, lasting for 8 to 12 hours.

The patches are perfect for managing pain, inflammation, and anxiety, making them suitable for both daytime and nighttime use. They can be applied to venous areas of the skin, such as the inner wrist or top of the foot, for optimal absorption and effectiveness.

1491.desc:
The REJUV THC Renew Transdermal Patch is formulated to provide effective relief through the slow release of THC directly into the bloodstream. These patches are designed for long-lasting effects, typically lasting between 8 to 12 hours, making them ideal for managing pain and promoting relaxation.

Each patch is discreet and easy to apply, providing an excellent alternative for those who prefer not to smoke or ingest cannabis. The transdermal delivery system ensures that cannabinoids bypass the digestive system, leading to quicker onset and more controlled effects. Simply apply the patch to a clean, dry area of skin for optimal results.

1492.desc: Blue Zoap is a hybrid cannabis strain bred by LIT Farms and made from a genetic cross of Blue 16 x Zoap. This strain is as beautiful as it is loud, with dense, deep indigo buds accented with green leaves, orange pistils, and heavy trichome frost. Blue Zoap has a deeply-layered profile of fruit, berry, and mossy earth; consumers can expect these notes to pair with both euphoric and relaxing effects. This is a potent strain with around 28% THC and best recommended for experienced cannabis users and medical patients. If you’ve smoked, dabbed, or consumed Blue Zoap, tell us about your experience by leaving a strain review.
